input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is a bare successors-and-assigns clause. Two of the three playbook limbs are satisfied: nothing restricts the Company's assignment (so our affiliate/M&A flexibility is intact), and no provision anywhere (including the Section 4 termination provisions) gives HDI a termination or re-pricing right on our change of control — no change-of-control language appears in the document at all. However, the clause contains no consent standard at all, so HDI is free to assign this hosting and site-development arrangement to any third party, including a competitor of ours. The fallback requires consent for non-successor assignments not to be unreasonably withheld, so the clause fails the fallback on that material term. Minimal edit adds the preferred consent standard (with the affiliate/successor carve-out for us and an express statement that our change of control is not an assignment), leaving the existing sentence untouched.

proposal.summary: Add assignment consent standard: Company free to assign to affiliates/successors; HDI needs our consent and may not assign to a competitor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 only confirms successors and assigns, leaving HDI free to assign this hosting arrangement to anyone, including a competitor of ours. We have added the customary consent standard: we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets without consent, while HDI needs our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and may not assign to our competitors. We can accept a mutual notice-and-consent formulation as a fallback.

ops.oldText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
ops.newText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement. The Company may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without HDI's consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in interest by way of merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the Company, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, and in no event may HDI assign this Agreement to a competitor of the Company. Any change of control of the Company shall not constitute an assignment or give HDI any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
